name: com.retailnetwork.commerce/customer-returns
title: Customer Returns MCP
description: The shopper-facing return authorization of the retail network: a return is authorized with its disposition decided at authorization (KEEP returnless below a caller-declared threshold, NEAREST_RETURNS_CENTER, ORIGIN_NODE), the reverse label comes from shipping-and-tracking, returns-processing receives the advices and grades the outcome, and offer-availability restocks the sellable units.
